description: This file contains test cases for the Tic Tac Toe application's frontend React components, focusing on rendering, interaction, winner detection, and reset functionality.

methods.name: test (description: 'renders title and reset button and 9 squares')
methods.description: Verifies that the app renders the game title, reset button, and 9 grid squares.

methods.name: test (description: 'clicking alternates X and O and status updates')
methods.description: Checks that clicking squares alternates player's mark and updates status message.

methods.name: test (description: 'detects winner and prevents further moves')
methods.description: Tests that the game detects a winner and prevents further moves after game end.

methods.name: test (description: 'reset clears the board')
methods.description: Verifies that clicking the reset button clears the game board and resets status.
